notes.title: Rollback of last update
notes.content:
Dear people,

in the last few days I have received a lot of reports about crashes and bugs in regards to our game.

[b]Effective immediately we well be rolling back our last update!
Everything will run as smooth as before!
We integrated the old code-base again, which is inferior, but more reliable![/b]

I will investigate what caused the crashes and bugs, and find the people at fault.
This will not happen again.

Wish you all a happy gaming,
Martin Jeremiah Apple

notes.title: HUGE UPDATE
notes.content:
Dearest gamers,

this update might not seem like much, but I assure you it is a huge update for me personally.

[b]I BASICALLY REWROTE ALL THE CODE![/b]

The game will now run smoother, look better, consume less power, have lower latency in multiplayer and will be over all a far superior experience.

On the surface there won't be any changes, be it in terms of content or UI, but under the hood everything is new and improved and ready for the future. This update will ensure, that the game has a bright future ahead of itself and that future content updates will be easy to integrate.

Personal note: this is a huge success for me as a programmer/person. After our coding team left, people told me to abandon the project. But I learned to code, and not only that: I also cleaned up and improved the existing code. So I have to confess I feel a lot of personal relief and satisfaction now that this update is released.

Have fun playing,
Martin Jeremiah Apple

notes.title: Update 0.9.5 - June 2024
notes.content:
Dear players,

it has been a while since the last update, but I can assure you that I, [u]Martin Jeremiah Apple[/u], am working hard and tirelessly to ensure the quality and vision of this game.
I am happy to annouce the following features for this new update:

[list]
[*]I integrated[b] STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]! Can you get them all?
[*]I reworked the ending, it is now better!
[*]I fixed some bugs and glitches!
[*]I corrected over 250 typos, which were overlooked by the former team!
[*]I did a lot of engine-related stuff. It was very complicated and would take too long to explain.
[/list]

Thank you for reading and for your continued support.
Your feedback is priceless to me!

Sincerly,
Martin Jeremiah Apple
Founder & CEO

notes.title: Update 0.9.1 (Splitscreen Update)
notes.content:
For this update we focused on the Splitscreen mode. We reworked some visuals and added more tracks, which you can play together on one keyboard or via Steam Remote Play.

[list]
[*]Added 5 new tracks for Splitscreen with different difficulties
[*]Reworked Splitscreen visuals
[*]Fixed minor bugs and glitches
[/list]

tags.feature: [*]Added 5 new tracks for Splitscreen with different difficulties

notes.title: Update 0.9.0b
notes.content:
Here is a small update with the following fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed reset and lighting bugs in the later city levels
[*]Fixed a bug where the diary is stuck when you advance dialogue with your mouse
[*]Multiplayer motivational dialogues are now skippable
[*]Multiplayer playing fields are now numbered
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.9.0a
notes.content:
After taking in all your feedback, we made the following changes:

[list]
[*]Work-level: fixed a bug where an Input Field was not clickable
[*]Diary-level: thought-bubbles are now clickable only once
[*]Dance-level: now shows you which buttons you have to press
[*]General: fixed some titles and text boxes
[/list]
